title: CopilotRepairPacket
description: Read-only scaffold presenting implementer-role repair items to Copilot. Copilot authority is bounded: no posting, approval, or merge operations permitted.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp in Zulu form, e.g. 2026-05-26T12:00:00Z.

copilot_authority.description: Governance pin: Copilot operates only as a bounded L1-L2 implementer. It must not post comments, approve PRs, merge PRs, enqueue merge queues, or alter readiness state.

mutation_performed.description: Governance pin: this scaffold performs no GitHub mutations.

source_action_plan_id.description: Optional reference to the ACTION_PLAN that produced these items.

id.description: Sequential repair item ID, e.g. repair-0001.

category.$comment: Restricted to implementer-role categories only. Source taxonomy: classifier._readiness() in tools/pr_action_bridge/compiler.py _BLOCKER_MAP. Supervisor-role categories (harvest-incomplete, pr-is-draft, pr-closed, mixed-sha, unknown-reviewer, proof-stale, unknown-check, needs-supervisor, embedded-audit-failed) and CI-role categories (pending-check) are intentionally excluded.

source_blocker.description: The raw blocker string from merge_readiness that produced this item.

source_item_id.description: Optional ID of the review item, thread, or check that is the source of this blocker.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of why this item is a blocker.

suggested_action.description: Concrete implementer action to resolve this item.
